subject: maths
title: Addition and Subtraction - Doubles and Counting On
introductionText:
Term 3 · Number
Addition and Subtraction — Doubles and
Counting On
The Big Idea: To add quickly, start with the bigger number and count on. A double is two
of the same number added together.
Say It Like This
Read aloud
"Try 4 + 9. Which is bigger? 9. Put 9 in your head and count on 4: ten, eleven, twelve,
thirteen. Much quicker than starting at 4! Now doubles. When you hold 3 beans in front of
a mirror, you see 3 more. Double 3 is 3 + 3 = 6. Your two hands are double 5 — that's 10.
Double 10 is 20."
Watch Out For
The slip almost every child makes
Double means "add one" or "add two". He says double 4 is 5 or 6. Hold up 4 fingers on
each hand: "Double means the same number again."
Thinking the order changes the answer. 2 + 8 and 8 + 2 are both 10. That's exactly why
we can start with the bigger number.
Try It at Home
Game 1 — Mirror doubles (5 minutes)
Put a small mirror on the table standing up. He puts 1 to 10 beans in front of it and says
the double he sees. Keep a list: double 1 is 2, double 2 is 4... Do you notice anything about
all the answers? (They're all even.)
Game 2 — Number stories (10 minutes)
Take turns telling tiny stories: "8 birds sat on the balcony. 4 more came. How many birds
now?" He acts it out with beans and writes the number sentence. Then he makes up a
story for you to solve.
Doubles in a mirror
4 + 9: start at 9, count on 4
8 9 10 11 12 13 14
9 + 4 = 13
double 3 = 3 + 3 = 6
Cover the mirror side and ask how many he'll see. Then trace the jumps from 9, counting on 4.
More examples to talk about
• Double 1 = 2, double 2 = 4, double 3 = 6, double 4 = 8, double 5 = 10.
• Double 6 = 12, double 7 = 14, double 8 = 16, double 9 = 18, double 10 = 20.
• Double 0 is still 0.
• Tricky: if double 7 is 14, then 7 + 8 is just one more: 15.
• Subtracting by counting back: 15 − 3 → fourteen, thirteen, twelve.

sourceQuestions.answerKeyText:
Any story where 6 things and 4 more things are joined to make 10, e.g. "6 cars were
parked, 4 more came, now there are 10."
